replies.author: Phobiaxx
replies.body:
Seems pretty good for a first map. ^-^
Suggestions:
1.Make the map larger
2.Bring the monuments WAY closer, and have the amount in proportion to how big the map is, with the current map size, I'd say 2-3.
3.Add a center of some sort, there isn't much space for melee combat
4.Make the iron mine larger
5.Make the front of the "U"'s Rendezvous style "ladder areas" larger and more decorated.(Can't really see)
6.Take more screenshots, some areas are hard to see
^-^
